What We Do

OUR SPECIALITIES

Expert craftsmanship on every project — from luxury pools to elegant bathrooms, stone work to commercial builds.

01
Swimming Pools

Full pool tiling — mosaic interiors, pool surrounds, waterline tiles, infinity edges, and resort-style finishes.

02
Bathrooms

Complete bathroom transformations — feature walls, floor-to-ceiling stone, wet rooms, and ensuite renovations.

03
Stone & Marble

Natural stone, marble, travertine, and large-format porcelain installed with precision and care.

04
Mosaics

Intricate mosaic tile work for pools, feature walls, and decorative accents. Bespoke patterns and custom layouts.

05
Residential

Kitchens, living areas, alfresco, and outdoor entertaining — full residential tiling from new builds to renovations.

06
Commercial

High-rise and commercial projects across Adelaide and Australia — rooftop pools, lobbies, large-format installations.

07
Waterproofing

Professional waterproofing membranes for wet areas, balconies, and pools. Done right before a single tile is laid.

08
Outdoor & Alfresco

Driveways, pool surrounds, entertaining areas, and garden paths — durable outdoor tiling built for the Australian climate.

Why Choose Us

BETTER THAN
THE REST

We don't just tile — we engineer surfaces that last decades. Obsessive attention to substrate preparation, adhesive selection, and grout finishing sets us apart from every other tiler in Adelaide.

01

Premium Materials Only

Top-tier adhesives, grouts, and waterproofing — we never cut corners on what goes behind the tile.

02

Specialist Pool Expertise

Hundreds of pools tiled including infinity edges, spas, curved walls, and rooftop installations.

03

On Time, Every Time

We coordinate with builders and trades to keep your project on schedule without compromise.

04

Fully Licensed & Insured

All work performed by licensed tilers with full public liability insurance. Complete peace of mind.

05

Australia-Wide Capability

Based in Adelaide but built to travel. We take on premium projects across all of Australia.
